genome_build: hg38 = GRCh38, confirmed from each GEO Sample_data_processing (Genome_build: hg38); not assumed
ensembl_release_note: GEO records confirm the hg38 (GRCh38) genome build but do not state the Ensembl annotation release, so pyensembl is pinned to release 104 (GRCh38, May 2021), contemporaneous with the GSE processing.
metric: SeedMatchR one-sided KS (D, p): seed-matched vs background log2FC over GRCh38/104 3'UTR-bearing genes; seed-match = any 3'UTR contains the site word

GSE196839.effect_table: count-derived: CPM-normalized log2((siGGGGGC+1)/(siNT1+1)), SINGLE replicate per condition (no authors' DESeq2 table in the GEO deposit)

siGGGGGC.note: siCAG (the other treated arm) is not run: its characteristics say 'siCAG', not explicitly 'siGGCAGU', so the seed is not confirmed from the GEO record.
